title: Viral Nuclease Inhibitors: Small molecule disruptors of the UL12 alkaline nuclease display broad anti-herpes virus activity.
authors: Sharma, Nidhi; Xie, Xiaoyun; Szczepaniak, Renata; Rani, Chitra; Khosro, Sheida Khojasteh; Krucinska, Jolanta; Chen, Xiaoling; Do, Dung; Wright, Lee; Wright, Dennis; Weller, Sandra
one_liner_zh: 该文研究疱疹病毒核酸酶UL12的小分子抑制剂，基于晶体结构进行药物设计，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) UL12 encodes a highly conserved 5' --> 3' alkaline exonuclease that is essential for the production of infectious virus. Together with the viral single-stranded DNA-binding/annealing protein ICP8, UL12 functions as a two-component recombinase that mediates recombination-dependent viral DNA replication. Here, we present the crystal structure of the catalytic domain of the HSV alkaline nuclease (UL12), which provides the first view of an alpha-herpesvirus alkaline nuclease. Using this structure, we optimized a series of small-molecule viral nuclease inhibitors (VNIs) that target the UL12 active site and potently inhibit UL12 exonuclease activity in vitro. We have thus established a robust platform for structure-based docking, SAR analysis and rational inhibitor design. Because UL12 orthologs are conserved across all human herpesviruses, we examined the activity of these compounds against the beta- and gamma-herpesvirus alkaline nucleases UL98 and SOX and found that they inhibit all three enzymes. The VNIs also exhibit antiviral activity against HSV-1 and HCMV in cell culture. EC50 and IC50 values were in the nanomolar to low micromolar range. Together, these findings establish herpesvirus alkaline nucleases as conserved, druggable antiviral targets and provide a foundation for the development of broad-spectrum anti-herpesvirus therapeutics, either as standalone agents or in combination with existing nucleoside analogs.
abstract_zh: 单纯疱疹病毒1型（HSV-1）的UL12基因编码一种高度保守的5'→3'碱性核酸外切酶，该酶对感染性病毒的产生至关重要。UL12与病毒单链DNA结合/退火蛋白ICP8共同构成双组分重组酶，介导依赖重组的病毒DNA复制。在此，我们展示了HSV碱性核酸酶（UL12）催化结构域的晶体结构，这是首次获得α-疱疹病毒碱性核酸酶的结构视图。利用该结构，我们优化了一系列靶向UL12活性位点的小分子病毒核酸酶抑制剂（VNIs），这些抑制剂在体外能有效抑制UL12核酸外切酶活性。因此，我们建立了一个稳健的平台，用于基于结构的对接、SAR分析和理性抑制剂设计。由于UL12直系同源物在所有人类疱疹病毒中均保守，我们检测了这些化合物对β-和γ-疱疹病毒碱性核酸酶UL98和SOX的活性，发现它们能抑制所有三种酶。VNIs在细胞培养中还表现出对HSV-1和人巨细胞病毒（HCMV）的抗病毒活性。EC50和IC50值处于纳摩尔至低微摩尔范围。综合这些发现，疱疹病毒碱性核酸酶被确立为保守且可药用的抗病毒靶点，并为开发广谱抗疱疹病毒疗法（无论是作为独立药物还是与现有核苷类似物联用）奠定了基础。
